authoring: 50 individually composed fictional records by a separate reviewing agent; no generator was used.
author_exposure: Author previously inspected the original synthetic generator and evaluation failures. This is not blinded human evaluation.
training_separation: Author did not inspect concurrently authored new training data or share benchmark contents with its author. Evaluation-only: do not train on this file.
label_policy: All five facts explicit; name/org/role labels are exact verbatim spans; age is age at appointment; year is appointment year.
limitations: Small authored diagnostic set, not a random real-world sample.
Author knew previous model failure modes.
No missing-fact or ambiguous-target evaluation because schema lacks abstention.
Ten examples per category give coarse estimates.
